_comment: Real-club fixture for Headland Buderim Croquet Club. Source: apps/club-sites/data/headland-buderim.md. Used to dry-run the pipeline against a real club's content before a true wizard submission.
tagline: Four lawns on the ridge, in the leafiest corner of the Sunshine Coast
about:
Some come for competition. Teams match up across the region, and the best get picked for State and national squads. Others come for the morning air, a bit of exercise, and the company. Both belong here.

Four full-size lawns on the ridge at Buderim. Open six days a week. Association, Golf Croquet, Ricochet, and Social Croquet.
play_schedule:
Monday 1 pm — Association
Tuesday 9 am — Golf Croquet
Tuesday 3 pm — Social
Wednesday 1 pm — Ricochet
Friday 9 am — Golf Croquet
Friday 3 pm — Social
Saturday 1 pm — Association
Sunday 9 am — Golf Croquet

Winter (Apr–Sep): Tuesday and Friday social sessions move to 2 pm.
come_and_try:
First session is free. All equipment supplied — bring flat shoes and a hat. Turn up to any session listed.

$15 coaching sessions available with qualified coaches in Golf and Association Croquet.
fees:
Come and Try (first session): free
Visitor, affiliated club: $10
Visitor, other: $15
Beginner coaching: $15 per session
Green fees, member daily: $8
Annual membership: $250
